# ALMA Pasta Machinery

> > Italian manufacturer of industrial fresh pasta production equipment and machinery since 1956

AL.MA. Srl specializes in designing and manufacturing professional pasta machinery including ravioli machines, gnocchi makers, pasta extruders, calibrators, and complete production lines for artisanal and industrial pasta makers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Fresh pasta machinery
- Ravioli production equipment
- Industrial pasta equipment
- Pasta extruders and presses
- Stainless steel AISI 304 construction
- Filled pasta machines
- Dough sheeting and calibration
- Cappelletti and gnocchi machines
- Italian manufacturing since 1956
- Trade shows: Pastaria, Host Milano, Sigep
- Automatic pasta cutting systems
- Commercial pasta production lines
- PLC-controlled machinery

## Company Information

- [AL.MA. Fresh Pasta Machinery | a Business Unit of AL.MA. Srl Packing and Packaging Machinery](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/en/company.html): AL.MA. Srl company profile: Italian pasta machinery manufacturer since 1956

## Ravioli and Filled Pasta Machines

- [RAVIOLATRICE MOD.RS160N](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/raviolatrice-mod-rs160n.html): Raviolatrice RS160N double-sheet ravioli production machine
- [RAVIOLATRICE MOD.R-160](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/raviolatrice-mod-r-160.html): Raviolatrice R-160 with SIEMENS PLC control and AISI 304 stainless steel
- [COMBINATA MOD.CA160R](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/combinata-mod-ca160r.html): Combined machine CA160R for ravioli production and pasta sheeting
- [MACCHINA PER CAPPELLETTI MOD.DN250/DN320](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/macchina-per-cappelletti-mod-dn250-dn320.html): Cappelletti machine models DN250/DN320 for filled pasta production

## Automatic Kneaders and Sheeters

- [Automatic kneader-sheeter MOD.CA250FD/CA300FD/CA320FD](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/en/automatic-kneader-sheeter-mod-ca250fd-ca300fd-ca320fd.html): Automatic kneader-sheeter CA250FD/CA300FD/CA320FD for filled pasta
- [Calibratore doppio](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/calibratore-doppio-mod-cal540-d.html): Double calibrator CAL540-D for dough sheeting and pasta production
- [Double calibrator MOD.CAL540-D](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/en/double-calibrator-mod-cal540-d.html): Double calibrator CAL540-D for industrial dough sheet calibration

## Pasta Extruders and Presses

- [Pressa MOD.PA250](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/pressa-mod-pa250.html): Pasta press MOD.PA250 with continuous mixing and extrusion capability
- [Pasta extruder MOD.PA55](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/en/pasta-extruder-mod-pa55.html): Pasta extruder PA55 for small-scale dough mixing and manufacturing

## Specialty Pasta Machines

- [MACCHINA PER GNOCCHI MOD.GN6](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/macchina-per-gnocchi-mod-gn6.html): Gnocchi machine MOD.GN6 in stainless steel for commercial production
- [Automatic pasta cutter MOD.TA160](https://www.alma-pasta-machinery.com/en/automatic-pasta-cutter-mod-ta160.html): Automatic pasta cutter TA160 for tagliatelle and fettuccine cutting
